summary: Full end-to-end testing of Dhanusha Production site. All backend endpoints (/api/leads POST+GET, /api/settings GET+PUT) work with correct persistence & ordering. All frontend flows tested: hero CTA, navbar, YouTube channels (featured + 9 cards), FAQ accordion, podcast teaser (next arrow & dots), contact form empty-validation + successful submission with backend persistence, and Admin testimonials toggle round-trip (default hidden -> ON shows section -> OFF hides again). show_testimonials reset to false at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER routes reference it (line 108 vs 65). It works at runtime because logging.basicConfig is called at import and logger name resolves at call time, but it's brittle — move logger + basicConfig above the routes.
server.py: /leads validation uses str for email (not EmailStr) — accepts malformed emails. Consider EmailStr for stronger validation.
Contact.jsx: no client-side email format validation before POST; relies solely on backend, which currently doesn't strictly validate email format.
seed_data_creation: A few TEST_ leads were inserted via API calls; harmless (GET /api/leads is admin-only surface).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings collection uses _id='site' singleton. Sonner toasts use selector li[data-type="success"|"error"] or [data-sonner-toast]. Lenis smooth-scroll present — use scroll_into_view_if_needed instead of hash nav. show_testimonials was reset to false at test end.
